development_data: October 21 snapshot ITF matched contracts, and any later replay of events after that cutoff performed after this freeze, are development analysis. They are not prospective.
identity: Kalshi participant UUID; name collisions are review candidates and are not merged

prospective.future_collection: A later research task may score this candidate on new WINDOW_CAPTURE records without connecting the scheduled sports collector.
prospective.rule: Only predictions actually recorded under this protocol before their outcomes became available qualify as prospective. Replaying events after 2026-10-21 now is development analysis even if those outcomes have not previously been scored.

reference: sports_phase1_v2 kalshi_only elo (frozen live candidate unchanged)
scheduler: none (not connected; future collection is documented only)

chronological_split.october_21_snapshot: development data; never used for selection

selection_rules.elo_state: separate per competition (k_kxitfmatch and k_kxitfwmatch never share ratings)
selection_rules.history: verified frozen normalized events only (capture protocol dependency hashes)
selection_rules.identity: Kalshi participant UUID; exact-name equality does not merge UUIDs
selection_rules.metric: mean log loss of P(home wins) on select-window events (clip eps=1e-4)
selection_rules.missing_input: refuse if frozen history hash mismatches; unseen player uses Elo base 1500; no independent results; no name merge
